listingTitle: Solino Home 100% Pure Linen Red Table Runner 72 Inches Long, 14 x 72 in
listingLines: Craftsmanship: Made from 100% pure European linen, featuring intricate hemstitch detailing and mitered corners. The natural linen texture creates a refined, timeless look with exceptional quality.
Certification: Certified by Masters of FLAX fibre and OEKO-TEX Standard 100.
Size: 14 x 72 Inch - usually recommended for 4–6-seater tables. Ideal for dining tables, hallway tables, cabinets, and dressers.
Color: Red | Please note that color may vary slightly due to lighting and individual screen settings.
Easy Care: Machine Washable, Low Iron as Needed, Steam Iron for a crisp look. Pure Linen mellows with each washing, betters with age and requires minimal care.

Natural Fibres: Like all fine linens and textiles, each batch of our linen is different and unique. Slight color, texture variations and wrinkles are an inherent quality of pure linen handcrafted pieces, adding to their relaxed beauty and bringing a wonderful heirloom feel to each.
Versatile Styling: Keep it monochromatic or mix and match coordinating colors, sizes, and styles beautifully, from everyday gatherings to celebrations.
summary: Elevate your dining experience with this 100% pure linen table runner in a rich red hue. It adds a touch of refined elegance to your table, perfect for both everyday meals and special occasions.
